title: Bess of Hardwick's Letters: The Complete Correspondence, c.1550-1608
institution: University of Glasgow (AHRC Letters of Bess of Hardwick Project), with the Digital Humanities Institute, University of Sheffield
notes:
Fully searchable online edition of all 234 letters to and from Elizabeth Talbot, Countess of Shrewsbury, with scholarly commentaries on material and linguistic features and downloadable data. Project ran 2008-2012; the edition remains online and maintained. Encoding of the downloadable data is unclear from the project page; the reading interface is HTML.

Justification: A complete scholarly digital edition of a major 16th-century correspondence corpus (Renaissance letters), freely accessible and not in the catalogue. Found via a general web search for new digital editions of Renaissance correspondence, confirmed on the Digital Humanities Institute project page.
Found at: https://www.dhi.ac.uk/projects/bess-of-hardwick/
